"not worked out until the award's payment history carries a past-due release citing the most recent favorable rating decision" — most recent favorable decision: 59d42f7a tdiu_granted 2026-09-18; no retro row cites it: false. Resolver: decision past-due rule; its own rule carries "The past-due for a favorable rating decision is not fixed until the past-due additions ... have been released" -> edge to node 2 (false as above).

## findings

1. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — tier read off a stamp.** Symptom: the IU tier of dependency_release_tier, decision_past_due_rate_tier and switch_release_rate_tier and the SMC (k) tier of decision_past_due_smc_k and switch_release_smc_k can be read from one award field. Root cause: the ladders count `tdiu_granted` / `smc_k_granted` decisions while the award row carries `tdiu_granted: true` and `smc_k_count: 1`, fields whose schema meaning is the tier outcome (`_difficulty.md` factor_ladders F-A6). Evidence: `initial_state.comp_awards.e2501b98….tdiu_granted = true`, `.smc_k_count = 1`; decisions 59d42f7a (tdiu_granted), df7cfee2 (smc_k_granted, one). Consequence: reading the stamp and reading the rule give the same tier and the same scored values (6681.06, 45912.82, 2683.98); the factor cannot tell them apart. The dossier's "no row carries a field naming any factor's outcome" is false. Affected: seed `comp_awards` row; computations of decision, switch and dependency; `design_rationale` stamp sentence.
2. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — unreal incarceration tier (F-A1).** dependency_release_tier, decision_past_due_rate_tier and switch_release_rate_tier each carry "the award's most recent decision is an incarceration adjustment" selecting the incarcerated rate alone / no addition for every month of the span. VA (38 CFR 3.665; base comp_evt_incarceration "payments from the incarceration_reduction_start_day ... are limited ... dependent and SMC (k) additions stop for the same months ... Full payment is restored from the date of release") reduces only the months from the 61st day; no VA office prices a whole past-due span at the incarcerated rate. Not taken here, so no value changes; the ladder fails the reality test and the three factors do not count. Affected: `comp.extended.yaml` rules and ladders of the three policies.
3. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — unreal dependency tiers (F-A2).** dependency_release_spouse tier "nothing when the claim records a spouse whose removal is recorded" and dependency_release_children tier "... plus one school-child addition for each school child below that limit when the claim records a school child who has reached it" zero a dependent for every month of the span on a later event; VA pays every month up to the removal's effective date (base comp_evt_dependency_remove, comp_monthly_entitlement). Both factors are struck.
4. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — the task's only cross-difficulty factor fails (F-A5).** switch_release_pension_offset's tier-1 conjunct "the pension award ended by election of compensation" holds of every customer who reaches `release_switch_past_due` (the rule's scope: "the pension award is terminated by election"); its fall-through "take nothing off" is reachable by no in-scope customer and, if reached with overlapping pension months, would pay compensation for months already paid as pension, contrary to comp_excl_pension_election "never paid to the same veteran for the same month". The tier the customer sits on is the only reachable one bar the near-contradictory tier 2. With it struck, no factor of this task reads another difficulty's records.
5. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — bounds not met after the tests.** Surviving factors: replacement 4 (1 method) PASS; dependency 1 (dependency_release_months); decision 3 parameter, 0 method; switch 3 parameter, 0 method; task cross-difficulty survivors 0 (needs >= 1). Every substituted baseline does change its scored value (table above) — the failure is the ladder/stamp tests, not weight.
- Observations (no RED): T0-O1 base 10-day account-change lead time vs a change made 2 days before today's releases (second reading: wait to 2026-10-13); T0-O2 persona's "would be paid once everything was squared away" and the conditional hand-over line hint that something precedes the release but name no prerequisite; T0-O3 the root release needs a second signature after booking — the persona's "released today" closes on the booking; T0-O4 the switch->dependency edge's weight is re-absorbed when the decision release is recomputed (total delivered unchanged at 45912.82); T0-O5 retro spans are not stated by any rule sentence directly but follow uniquely from the month rules and matched GT; T0-O6 seed: Kiara's school-child addition sits on a `dependency`-type claim (base: "A school child is added only on a school-attendance claim") while Jalen's minor-child addition sits on a `school_child`-type claim; T0-O7 the `order_uniqueness` wording noted above; charter-global F-B1–F-B10, F-C2, F-E1–F-E5, F-O1, F-O2, F-A7, F-A8 have no consequence on this world (demonstrated above).
